title: Support Wear 2.0 Complications
symptom: The user requests support for Wear 2.0+ complications in the xDrip watchface, so that users can customize the watchface by adding their own preferred additional information (e.g., date, weather, fitness tracker) from system or third-party apps.
evidence_quote: it would be nice if Wear 2.0+ complications were supported, so you could customise the watchface by adding your own preferred additional information
